mapper.select: SELECT id, name, address, type_code, type, level, institution_nature, devices, workers, sum_people, beds, province, city, county, country, unit_head, telephone, lon AS longitude, lat AS latitude, ST_AsText(point) AS geomText, -- 计算距离（米）用于验证和排序 ST_Distance( ST_Transform(point, 3857), ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{longitude}, #{latitude}), 4490), 3857) ) AS distance_meters FROM xian_hospitals WHERE -- 使用3857坐标系计算圆形范围（单位：米） ST_Distance( ST_Transform(point, 3857), ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{longitude}, #{latitude}), 4490), 3857) ) <= 20000 -- 5000米（20公里） ORDER BY distance_meters
